title: Can't Love, Can't Hurt
passages: Can't Love, Can't Hurt is the second album by Augustana, a California rock band. The album was released on April 29, 2008, by Epic Records. The album debuted at number 21 on the U.S. Billboard 200 chart, selling over 21,000 copies in its first week.
An iTunes exclusive EP was released on February 26, 2008 to promote the album featuring the first three tracks from the album.
All songs written by Dan Layus and Mike Flynn.
"Either Way, I'll Break Your Heart Someday" – 4:11
